rules.condition: gut noise present (nausea, bloating, reflux, constipation) AND headache
rules.action: treat gut first — MyGastrin + Fiber before migraine-specific intervention

rules.condition: headache dominant WITHOUT GI symptoms
rules.action: use Promigraine / membrane module directly; do not default to GI-first

rules.condition: neck-initiated pain, fixed side, no aura, no GI link, worsens with neck movement
rules.action: cervicogenic protocol — local laser C2-C5 GB SI BL; Collagen/RegenOil; Kudzu. Do NOT use migraine drugs as sole treatment.

rules.condition: dry component present in formula
rules.action: exclude Ginger from Pack 1

rules.condition: joint shows active heat / swelling / evening worsening
rules.action: stabilise only — do NOT add Collagen, ProCardiol, or strong MyBlood

rules.condition: joint heat subsiding, pain character shifting from burning to stiff
rules.action: advance to phase 2 — add low-dose MyBlood; Collagen still excluded

rules.condition: joint: no active heat, movement improves, pain is 'empty' not inflamed
rules.action: advance to phase 3 — introduce Collagen; increase MyBlood to normal dose; consider ProCardiol if improvement not sustained

rules.condition: warming agent, exercise, or Collagen alone causes rapid worsening of joint
rules.action: classify as inflammation still dominant — return to phase 1 stabilisation

rules.condition: improvement occurred then relapsed without structural support
rules.action: classify as structure not yet supported — remain in phase 2 longer before phase 3

rules.condition: CGRP inhibitor in use AND ≥2 of: migraine quieter but no energy / constipation worsened / flat affect / reduced tolerance / GI worsening / 'quieter but not better'
rules.action: initiate CGRP exit support — grounding phase first (Fiber + Spirulina + hydration); do not stop CGRP without phenotype-specific support in place

rules.condition: CGRP exit step 1 complete AND no migraine rebound
rules.action: advance to step 2 — add RegenOil or D+Nigella for membrane repair

rules.condition: CGRP exit step 2 complete
rules.action: phenotype-tune in step 3 BEFORE reducing CGRP dose

rules.condition: CGRP exit: severe uncontrolled migraine OR active quality-of-life impairment OR patient feels unsafe
rules.action: do NOT exit — run Base44 support protocol alongside CGRP; do not replace

rules.condition: medication requires increasing dose OR effect shortening OR new GI/fatigue/brain fog symptoms
rules.action: assess system capacity first — stabilise before escalating or switching medication

rules.condition: system capacity: cannot process load
rules.action: stabilise first (MyGastrin + Fiber or Spirulina); do not add more interventions

rules.condition: system capacity: can process load
rules.action: modulate specifically by current dominant symptom branch (gut / energy / membrane / local)

rules.condition: migrating or shifting pain character
rules.action: membrane stabilisation — RegenOil or D+Nigella

rules.condition: isolated traumatic neck pain OR purely mechanical injury OR acute GI with fever/inflammation
rules.action: use local or acute protocol — do NOT apply GI-migraine-neck axis logic

rules.condition: TCA/SNRI in use (amitriptyline, duloxetine)
rules.action: add Spirulina (mitochondrial), Fiber (autophagy grounding), MyGastrin if GI complaints

rules.condition: antipsychotic used off-label for pain
rules.action: use only transitionally; always combine with stabilisation protocol

rules.condition: ginger tea prescribed
rules.action: morning or midday ONLY — never evening; weak-to-medium strength

rules.condition: mixed joint state: mixed → sequence, don't stack
rules.action: enforce phase sequence; do not combine phase 1 and phase 3 interventions simultaneously

rules.condition: mixed joint state: unsure which phase
rules.action: wait one phase longer before advancing

rules.condition: photophobia + phonophobia + irritability dominant
rules.action: neuro-sensory phenotype — ProSelect + Melatonin (evening) + Spirulina; avoid stimulants and yang tonics

notes: All patterns in this batch are from Base44/Avicenna 2 source documents — language is original author's model, integrating TCM meridian logic with functional Western pathophysiology.
DuoLife product names (MyGastrin, MyBlood, ProCardiol, Spirulina, etc.) are proprietary supplement product names — map to generic functional categories if needed for non-DuoLife deployment.
CGRP exit strategy: requires minimum 3-step sequence before CGRP dose reduction; never replace, only support.
Mixed OA-RA transition state: collagen is contraindicated in phases 1 and 2 — this is a critical safety rule.
Ginger: excluded from Pack 1 when dry component present (R004); excluded from evening use (R021).
Migraine vs cervicogenic headache: not interchangeable — different upstream drivers, different first-line interventions.
